name: Detonate
description: Explode latent energy in objects for 1-10 dmg in 10ft radius. May disintegrate items.

name: Disintegrate
description: Reduces creature to ash on failed save vs death magic.

name: Project Force
description: Psychokinetic punch at 200 yards. 1-6 dmg + target's AC.

name: Ballistic Attack
description: Throw small object at deadly speed. 1-6 dmg.

name: Control Body
description: Control another's body. -6 to attack rolls.

name: Inertial Barrier
description: Halves damage from breath weapons missiles gas acid ice storms.

name: Animal Affinity
description: Grow claws 1-10 dmg.

name: Energy Containment
description: No effect from electricity cold fire heat sound energy attacks.

name: Life Draining
description: Drain up to 6 HP from another. Added temporarily.

name: Absorb Disease
description: Transfer disease to self then cure it. Cannot absorb curses.

name: Adrenalin Control
description: +1 to +6 STR temporarily.

name: Biofeedback
description: Reduce damage by 2. AC +1.

name: Body Weaponry
description: Use one arm as a weapon (wood or steel).

name: Cell Adjustment
description: Heal wounds and cure diseases. Cannot remove curses.

name: Displacement
description: Project image 3 feet away. AC +2.

name: Enhanced Strength
description: Raise STR to 24. 2x PSP per point added.

name: Flesh Armor
description: Temporary armor based on level. No penalties.

name: Graft Weapon
description: Weapon becomes part of body. +1 to hit. Cannot switch.

name: Lend Health
description: Transfer HP to another. Cannot exceed target's max or drop self below minimum.

name: Share Strength
description: Transfer STR to another (2 lost for 1 received).

name: Domination
description: Control another's mind. PSP cost depends on subject.

name: Mass Domination
description: Up to 5 creatures at once.

name: Psychic Crush
description: Up to 6 HP damage on psionicist's mind.

name: Superior Invisibility
description: Cannot be seen heard or smelled. Dispelled if user attacks.

name: Tower of Iron Will
description: Defense vs psionic contact. Can initiate one other power while warded.

name: Ego Whip
description: Stun target 1-4 rounds.

name: Id Insinuation
description: Paralyze target 1-4 rounds.

name: Intellect Fortress
description: Telepathic defense for all minds within 3 yards.

name: Mental Barrier
description: Personal defense only. Can use other powers while protected.

name: Mind Bar
description: 75% magic resistance to mind-affecting spells.

name: Mind Blank
description: Always on. Defense vs psionic attacks. Free.

name: Psionic Blast
description: Tricks opponent into believing it lost 80% HP. At 20% HP falls unconscious.

name: Synaptic Static
description: Prevents ALL psionics in area (including user).

name: Thought Shield
description: Protect mind from psionic attacks. Can initiate another power simultaneously.
